xero.accountCodeDescription:
In Flowclass settings, all income from Flowclass will be grouped together under one “Account Code” in Xero. 

An account code is just a number, usually between 100 and 999, that Xero uses to help you organize and track your money. 

You can either use an account code that already exists, or create a new one just for Flowclass income. This makes it easy to see all your Flowclass earnings in one place in your Xero reports.
